title: Gavan and Penta (2025)
headline: The mechanism displayed in the proof of Theorem 3 admits an unwanted Nash equilibrium in an admitted instance. The existential conclusion of Theorem 3 is not refuted.

claims.label: Theorem 3 proof construction
claims.gist: The four-rule message mechanism displayed in the proof implements the correspondence throughout the stated domain.
claims.statement: The four-rule message mechanism displayed in the proof of Theorem 3 implements F under the theorem's hypotheses for every admissible integer 1 ≤ k < n/2.
claims.quantifiers: Every admitted environment satisfying the hypotheses of Theorem 3 and every admissible safety level k.

result.summary: The displayed mechanism can select an outcome outside F at a pure Nash equilibrium.
result.witness: With one state, outcomes {a,b}, F={b}, three agents and k=1, let agents 1 and 2 prefer b to a and agent 3 prefer a to b. At messages ((a,s,1),(a,s,1),(b,s,1)), the printed rules select a, outside F. The two agents who prefer b cannot profitably change the outcome by switching their report, and agent 3 already receives her preferred outcome.
result.tested: The minimal three-agent witness was checked against the published Rules (i)–(iv), the theorem's stated assumptions and the legal unilateral reports. Historical finite checks and a separate informed AI validation corroborate the construction failure.
not_claimed: The existential conclusion of Theorem 3 is not claimed to be false.
The record does not claim that no alternative mechanism can safely implement F.
The record does not publish or assess any private proposed correction.

vor_check.detail: The definitions, Theorem 3, the displayed Rules (i)–(iv) and the decisive proof step were checked on rendered pages of the publisher-hosted version of record.

checks.detail: A separate informed AI validation checked the analytic failure family against the printed mechanism.
A qualifying human confirmation is recorded in the private research file. Its source and correspondence are not disclosed.

history.label: Construction defect identified and separately rechecked

statements.ai_use: AI systems were used for discovery and separate hostile rechecking. Confirmation also includes a qualifying human check recorded privately. Private correspondence is not disclosed, and AI agreement is not treated as human verification.
